transcript:
Advisor: Hi Walter, it's Sarah. You left a message that it was urgent?
Walter: Yes. Who is this again?
Advisor: It's Sarah Lin, your advisor. We've worked together for twelve years.
Walter: Right, Sarah. Sorry. I need $60,000 wired today, it's urgent.
Advisor: Okay, let's slow down. What's the wire for?
Walter: Daniel found an opportunity. It closes Friday. If I don't act this week I'll miss out, he says. It goes to his account, he's handling it for me. The account number is 000-123456-00.
Advisor: Walter, sending money into Daniel's personal account is very different from anything we've done before.
Walter: He's going to be on my account soon anyway. I want to add Daniel to the account. Make him the beneficiary too.
Advisor: That's a major change. Ellen is your beneficiary and your trusted contact right now.
Walter: Please don't mention this to Ellen, she worries. She'll just make a fuss.
Advisor: I hear you. Can I ask, when did you decide on this?
Walter: Today. Daniel says it has to be today. I need $60,000 wired today. Did I say that? Sixty thousand. Today.
Advisor: You did. Walter, I want to help you, and I also want to make sure this is what you really want. Wires like this take some processing time on our side.
Walter: Daniel said you'd say that. Just do it, please.
Advisor: I'm going to put a note on this and call you back this afternoon. Is that okay?
Walter: Fine. But it has to be today.
